note: With weak archetype separation (dominant-label weight ~6-7x background) and few sessions (6 sessions x 10 responses), KMeans ARI was only ~0.53-0.58 and HDBSCAN failed to find clusters at all -- both archetype separation strength AND number of observations per student materially affect recoverability. With stronger separation (~10-13x) and more observations (10 sessions x 20 responses), KMeans reaches ARI=0.97 and HDBSCAN 0.90. This parameter sensitivity is itself a real finding worth reporting in Ch.5: recoverability of difficulty profiles depends on how many responses are observed per student, which has a direct implication for how much data a real deployment needs to collect before profiles become reliable.
